programs.name: sugethw
programs.purpose: Print selected trace header values as text or binary floats.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUGETHW - sugethw writes the values of the selected key words

params.name: key
params.description: Header words to print; positional header names are also accepted.

params.name: output
params.description: Output format: ascii, binary, or geom.

params.name: verbose
params.description: Print diagnostic messages.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Binary output converts header values to float, potentially losing integer precision.
programs.difficulty_reason: It reads traces and formats selected header values.

test_cases.description: Print two header words in geometry format.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=32 ntr=4 | sugethw key=tracl,cdp output=geom

test_cases.description: Write header values as binary floats.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=32 ntr=4 | sugethw key=tracl,ns output=binary

programs.name: suhtmath
programs.purpose: Apply arithmetic to each trace using a scaled header value.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUHTMATH - do unary arithmetic operation on segy traces with

params.name: key
params.description: Header word used in the arithmetic.

params.name: op
params.description: Operation: add, mult, or div. Although documented, nop is rejected by the code.

params.name: scale
params.description: Multiplier for the header value.

params.name: const
params.description: Constant added to the scaled header value.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Header values are converted to float before the arithmetic; division by zero is not checked. The first trace's sample count is used for every trace.
programs.difficulty_reason: It performs simple per-sample arithmetic using a header value.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=32 ntr=4 | suhtmath key=tracl op=add scale=0.5 const=1

test_cases.description: Divide by a nonzero header-derived value.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=32 ntr=4 | suhtmath key=tracl op=div scale=1 const=2

programs.name: supaste
programs.purpose: Combine saved trace headers with binary sample data to reconstruct SU traces.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUPASTE - paste existing SU headers on existing binary data

params.name: ns
params.description: Number of samples per output trace.

params.name: head
params.description: File containing saved trace headers.

params.name: ftn
params.description: Set to 1 to skip Fortran record markers.

params.name: verbose
params.description: Report the number of traces pasted.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Binary sample and record-marker formats depend on native representation.
programs.difficulty_reason: It pairs saved headers with fixed-size sample records.

test_cases.description: Strip and restore ordinary C-format sample records.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=32 ntr=4 | sustrip head=headers outpar=strip.par > samples.bin && supaste ns=32 head=headers verbose=1 < samples.bin
suplane nt=32 ntr=4 | sustrip head=headers outpar=strip.par ftn=1 > samples.bin && supaste ns=32 head=headers ftn=1 < samples.bin

programs.name: surandhw
programs.purpose: Set or perturb a trace header using random values.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: surandhw - set header word to random variable

params.name: key
params.description: Header word to update.

params.name: a
params.description: Multiplier for the existing header value; the self-doc incorrectly states a default of 0.

params.name: min
params.description: Lower bound or Gaussian scaling endpoint.

params.name: max
params.description: Upper bound or Gaussian scaling endpoint.

params.name: noise
params.description: Random distribution: gauss or flat.

params.name: seed
params.description: Random generator seed.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Random sequences depend on the SU generator implementation; arithmetic mixes generator results and doubles before conversion to the header type. The double-header case falls through to an error.
programs.difficulty_reason: It generates one random value and updates one header per trace.

test_cases.description: Set a header from a reproducible uniform distribution.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=32 ntr=4 | surandhw key=tstat a=0 noise=flat min=0 max=100 seed=42

test_cases.description: Add reproducible Gaussian noise to a header.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=32 ntr=4 | surandhw key=tstat a=1 noise=gauss min=-10 max=10 seed=42

programs.license_note: Credits Eric Verschuur, Delft University of Technology; based on sushw.

programs.name: sustrip
programs.purpose: Remove SU trace headers and write the sample data as binary records.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUSTRIP - remove the SEGY headers from the traces

params.name: head
params.description: File in which to save trace headers.

params.name: outpar
params.description: File receiving sample count, trace count, and sample interval.

params.name: ftn
params.description: Set to 1 to write Fortran-style record markers.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Sample bytes and Fortran record markers use native representation; packed trace types output bytes or shorts rather than floats.
programs.difficulty_reason: It separates headers and fixed-size sample records.

test_cases.description: Save headers and ordinary sample data.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=32 ntr=4 | sustrip head=headers outpar=strip.par > samples.bin
suplane nt=32 ntr=4 | sustrip head=headers outpar=strip.par ftn=1 > samples.bin

programs.name: sutrcount
programs.purpose: Count the traces in an SU input stream.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUTRCOUNT - SU program to count the TRaces in infile

params.name: outpar
params.description: File receiving the ASCII trace count.

programs.difficulty_reason: It counts traces in a single pass.

test_cases.description: Write the trace count to stdout.
Write the count to a file.
